name: orka
description: Make your best coding agent the CTO. Let cheaper agent CLIs do the work.

interface.shortDescription: Make your best coding agent the CTO. Let cheaper agent CLIs do the work.
interface.longDescription: Orka turns your strongest agent into a manager: it keeps the backlog in your words, writes task cards and dispatches them to cheaper headless coding-agent CLIs (Codex, Grok, Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode) or native sub-agents, each in its own git worktree. A different model reviews every critical change, the orchestrator re-runs the acceptance itself, the junior does browser QA and research, and every run is scored in a ledger.
